{{Top|leg}}
'''Oro Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was composed of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].

During the operation against [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], Oro Squadron was assigned to escort a convoy of Rebel ships bearing the needed supplies and personnel to construct a shipyard in the area. However, the Empire had learned of the convoy and [[Battle of Rocrin|readied a trap]] in the [[Rocrin system/Legends|Rocrin system]]. Oro Squadron was torn from hyperspace along with the rest of the convoy by [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]''. Oro, seeking to defend its charges, engaged incoming Imperial bombers. Despite reinforcements from the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] of [[Ulan Squadron]], the whole squadron was wiped out by Imperial forces.
